```artifact
Feature: Doctor and Chemist/Lab Management System

  Background:
    As a user of the medical management system,
    I expect to be able to manage doctors and chemists/labs effectively.

  Scenario: Add a new unique Doctor
    Given a new doctor needs to be added to the system
    When the system prompts for Doctor details
    Then the system should accept the following details:
      | Name      | Example         | As specified
      | John Doe   | JD              |
      | Jane Smith | JS              |

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details - Speciality Unchangeable
    Given a doctor's details are already in the system
    When attempting to update the doctor's speciality
    Then the system should reject the update and alert the user
      | Expected Alert | "Speciality cannot be updated" |

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details - No Pending Consultation
    Given a doctor's details are in the system with no pending consultation requests
    When requesting to delete the doctor
    Then the doctor's details should be removed from the system
      | Expected Outcome | "Doctor deleted successfully" |

  Scenario: Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given a new chemist or lab needs to be added to the system
    When the system prompts for Chemist/Lab details
    Then the system should accept the following details:
      | Chemist/Lab Name | Example         | As specified
      | Lab A          | Lab A           |

  Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details - Pincode Immutable
    Given a chemist/lab's details are already in the system
    When attempting to update the chemist/lab's pincode
    Then the system should reject the update and alert the user
      | Expected Alert | "Pincode cannot be updated" |

  Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab Details - No Pending Prescription
    Given a chemist/lab's details are in the system with no pending prescriptions
    When requesting to delete the chemist/lab
    Then the chemist/lab's details should be removed from the system
      | Expected Outcome | "Chemist/Lab deleted successfully" |
```
